INSERT INTO ofsafe_facility ( fclt_nm, fclt_se_cd, ctpv_nm, sgg_nm, road_nm_addr, lat, lot, opn_yn, use_yn, reg_dt ) VALUES
( #{item.fcltNm}, #{item.fcltSeCd}, #{item.ctpvNm}, #{item.sggNm}, #{item.roadNmAddr}, #{item.lat}, #{item.lot}, COALESCE(#{item.opnYn}, 'Y'), 'Y', NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fclt_se_cd = VALUES(fclt_se_cd), ctpv_nm = VALUES(ctpv_nm), sgg_nm = VALUES(sgg_nm), road_nm_addr = VALUES(road_nm_addr), lat = VALUES(lat), lot = VALUES(lot), opn_yn = VALUES(opn_yn), reg_dt = NOW()
